_help: Hand-entered data for things with no free API. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Add new entries to the end of each list; the tracker re-reads the whole file every run.
_lease_rate_help: One-month silver lease rate in percent (e.g. from Bloomberg, Kitco commentary, or LBMA-derived SIFO/forward rates).
_shanghai_help: SGE Ag(T+D) settlement price in CNY per kg, as quoted (VAT-inclusive). The tracker strips 13% VAT and converts to USD/oz.
_registered_help: COMEX registered silver in troy ounces. Only needed when the CME download fails (it often blocks automated requests).
_exchange_help: type is one of: margin_hike, liquidation_only, forced_cash_settlement, trade_cancellation, trading_halt, position_limit_change, delivery_default.

_state_help: Disclosed state or central bank silver purchases, reserve programs, or export controls. Dates marked approx are month-level.
